text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming p99 > 2.5s for dedicated pool `d-prod-12` in eu-west-1. SLO breach firing (SLO=2s). Queue depth rising, warmup miss rate spiking. Paging @oncall-michelle. incident_id=INC-8054321. Auto-escalate to eng-sre/infra if unresolved in 10m.

oncall-michelle: on it. grabbing logs + prometheus slices. triage channel? tagging eng-sre and infra. any customer-visible errors?

sam (eng-runtime): seeing a spike in KV-cold-path hits during burst window. streaming sessions showing repeated `send_chunk` stalls. Autoscaler attempted provisioning but there are `handshake_timeout` entries:```
handshake: alloc_slot d-prod-12 req=+4 t=45s err=handshake_timeout
warmup: kv_load miss model=gpt-large ver=2026-02 hash=0x9f.. count=38
stream: send_chunk stall client_id=xyz duration=3000ms
```

akshay (infra): autoscaler telemetry: `slot_alloc_attempts=3 slot_alloc_failures=2 slot_alloc_latency=38s median`. Warmup task queue length=42, warmup-success-rate dropped to 12% during burst. Looks like newly provisioned nodes are not completing warmup within handshake window -> handshake backoff triggers and autoscaler gives up.

jamie (eng-sre): probable chain = sudden hotspot (hotshot ingress) -> many cold KV loads -> warmup overload -> autoscaler handshake timeouts -> queue accumulates -> streaming p99 spikes. Immediate mitigations: 1) manual scale-up of pool to short-circuit autoscaler; 2) temporarily route 10-20% traffic to fallback model variant (quantized/tiny) to shed load; 3) enforce backpressure thresholds (throttle new sessions) and shorten max tokens for streaming.

oncall-michelle: doing manual-scale now. /run manual-scale d-prod-12 add=4 reason="warmup-handshake-timeouts"

ops-bot: Manual scale request received: user=oncall-michelle pool=d-prod-12 add=4. Provisioning started. ETA ~90s.

leo (customer-ops): pinging CS for customer impact. @ryan-cs any reports?

ryan-cs: seeing ~12 customer sessions with streaming stalls + 5 error reports (timeout). One enterprise customer (acct: AcmeCorp) observed retries and user-facing slowdowns. CS opened ticket #TCK-8023 and started outreach. ETA to update customer in 30m.

katie (support): logging affected request IDs we see: rids=[A3f9, B2k1, C7m2]. Customers: chat endpoints mostly. Adding to incident tracker.

sam (eng-runtime): extra telemetry: `kv_warmup_time_p95=3.2s`, `kv_warmup_time_p99=6.1s`. Autoscaler config shows `handshake_deadline=30s`. That explains handshake_timeout entries. Warmup for large model commonly >30s under heavy disk I/O.

akshay (infra): agree. options: increase handshake_deadline to 90s temporarily (risk longer resource hold), or pre-warm nodes before adding to pool (preferred). Manual scale is live, starting pre-warm hook on new nodes.

jamie (eng-sre): while scale completes: enable routing fallback. sam can you flip routing to send 15% to `gpt-large-quantized-v1`? add temporary rate limit 80% for new sessions to avoid queue blowout.

sam (eng-runtime): routing change applied: `route(d-prod-12) -> fallback:gpt-large-quantized-v1 weight=15%`. New session throttle set: `session_admit_threshold=0.8`.

ops-bot: Provisioning update: 2/4 nodes ready, warmup in progress on each.

oncall-michelle: monitoring p95/p99. current metrics: p95=1.1s, p99=2.8s, queue_depth=36, warmup_failures=4. manual-scale in-flight.

leo (customer-ops): customer update drafted: "We're aware of increased response times for streaming in eu-west-1 and are actively mitigating. We'll follow up within 30 minutes." Ready to send on your go.

jamie (eng-sre): if autoscaler handshake is the root cause, file immediate follow-ups: - raise handshake_deadline for dedicated pools during known bursts - add pre-warm/windowed warmup threshold - adjust autoscaler retry/backoff to avoid giving up at 2 attempts. We'll make a temporary config change only if manual scale doesn't restore SLO soon.

ops-bot: Provisioning update: 4/4 nodes ready. Warmup complete on 3/4, 1 node showing slower dvfs warmup.

sam (eng-runtime): warmup success improving. p99 dropping: p99=1.9s, p95=0.95s, queue_depth=18. Looks like manual scale + routing took effect.

katie (support): AcmeCorp updated. They confirm partial recovery but still saw a retry flow. CS will follow up post-incident.

oncall-michelle: thanks team. keeping channel open for 20m to ensure stability. next steps: follow-up playbook + config PR. Can someone pick the postmortem?

jamie (eng-sre): I'll own postmortem. immediate actions (short-term): 1) bump `handshake_deadline` to 90s for d-prod-12 as canary; 2) create warmup pre-provision hook to run model KV warmup before slot considered healthy; 3) add autoscaler metric alert for `slot_alloc_failures>1` in 5m window.

akshay (infra): deploying handshake_deadline bump to canary now on d-prod-12. Will monitor.

ops-bot: Config change applied to d-prod-12: `handshake_deadline=90s (canary)` by akshay.

sam (eng-runtime): note: need a longer-term optimization: reduce cold-path IO by keeping KV caches across churn, plus prioritizing warmup tasks for inbound hotshot traffic. I'll add this to postmortem action items.

ryan-cs: logged customer impact: 12 sessions, 5 error reports, 1 enterprise with retries. CS follow-up scheduled.

non-urgent update (10m later): p99 stable at 1.6s, queue_depth=6. No new error reports in last 8m.

oncall-michelle: closing live mitigation. creating incident ticket INC-8054321-POST with timeline and assigned owners. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

jamie (eng-sre): postmortem owners: jamie (lead), sam (runtime), akshay (infra), katie (support), leo (ops). Action items due by EOD + follow-up retro next week.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-8054321. Severity: S3. Root cause: autoscaler handshake deadline too short for warmup under burst -> warmup queue saturation -> p99 streaming stalls. Follow-ups: playbook, config PR, KV cache retention improvements."
